svg.text: ÉCLOS COMPACT — WHAT THE ORIGINAL MODEL WAS MISSING
Same planes, same scale (3:1). Orange = the original surfaces as found, at true scale; filled = r1. Measured: audit/source/source_audit.json, audit/r1_audit.json, audit/build_log.json.
orig. A–A x = 0
r1 A–A x = 0
orig. B–B y = 0
r1 B–B y = 0
FINDINGS → r1
Closed, the lid sinks 0.57 into the base: frame and cap overlap the tray wall. It also sits 0.18
toward the back.
→ Lid seated on the rim with the base's own outline: closed height 11.68, parting line flush; r1
has no interference (max 0.006 at intended contacts).
Powder is a solid block from the floor to 6.47; no pan, no way to refill. Floor is a 0.12 plate.
→ Two tinplate godets (0.30 wall) in a bonded insert, each on a Ø8 × 1 magnet; 2.13 cm³ of
powder each; base floor 1.5.
Divider between the shades is a zero-thickness surface.
→ 1.0 rib in the insert; godet-to-well clearance 0.149 measured.
Hinge: a Ø2.1 barrel and two blocks in notches; tray has 12 open edges there and at the front
notch. No pin, no knuckles, no stop.
→ 3 knuckles, Ø0.8 pin; base relief swept from the lid's back strip; first contact at 108.5°
(0.5° steps) is the stop.
Nothing holds the lid shut; the 'click' tab overlaps the base (33 intersecting triangle pairs).
→ Ø3 × 1.5 magnet pair at the front, 1.59 air gap; the front notch is kept as an open thumb
lift.
Mirror is a 0.06 sheet under the cap, with no recess or fixing; as drawn (lid sunk) it sits 1.16
above the embossed powder.
→ Ø40.4 × 1.1 glass bonded in a recess (0.1 adhesive); 1.81 clear of the embossed powder when
closed.
ÉCLOS lettering engraved 0.08 deep at true scale.
→ Same glyphs, 0.30 deep so they read after plating.
Drawn at 8.0 mm across (model units read as mm).
→ ×6.875: 55.00 across the flats, the width of the round ÉCLOS compact (Ø55.0 in SCENE-2).
OPEN (not solved in r1)
· Magnet grades and pull forces (closure and godet retention): supplier data and pull tests.
· Hinge stop load: contact is a strip about 0.3 deep behind the axis; drop test, or a steel stop insert
if needed.
· Zinc casting: section thickness, porosity and gate positions need a casting review; base + lid ≈ 83 g
at an assumed 6.6 g/cm³.
· Decoration detail from the original artwork: narrowest land between engraved strokes 0.13, narrowest
relief stroke 0.23; check with the engraving / tooling process.
· Insert bonding (adhesive or heat stake), insert material and any recycled-content claim to be
confirmed with the final supplier.
· Mirror adhesive, glass edge finish; powder fill weight from the formulator's density; no locating lip
at the parting line (alignment by the hinge).
